test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 16 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**​Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

He was __so confident then__ nothing could hinder his success.
solution:
The correct answer is "**so confident that**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the use of the coordinating conjunction "**then" **is incorrect.
 
• We use "then" in a sentence to mark time or talk about a sequence of events.
 
• We need to use **that as a clause** in the given sentence.
 
• In the given sentence, that as a clause after the adjective "**confident**" expresses an **opinion\feeling** about the person(subject).
 
• The speaker wants to say that this person was so confident **that **nothing could stop him from achieving success.

**The correct sentence is**: *He was **so confident that__** nothing could hinder his success.*

Hence, the correct answer is** option 3.**
